Name: Wrong Keg and Wrong Jar
Author: DiamondGrey
Description:
These craftables do the opposite of what you usually expect.
Wrong Keg create Juices from Fruits and Wine from Vegetables.
Wrong Jar creates Pickles from Fruits and Jellies from Vegetables.

Artisan Goods created in this way are NOT obtainable through CJB Item Spawner, but work correctly with [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]EBAGI mod[/url].
You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54102337]Shreedle[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15761]Wrong Artisan Good Icons[/url].











Version 1.0 
﻿I added two compatibility patches for Tithrandel's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11752?tab=description]Floral Liquors[/url]﻿ and Wickedy's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15055?tab=description]Floral Essences[/url] mods.
The two mods don't get along very well, because they both use the same Keg Production Rule.
The patches apply the production rule to the Wrong Keg instead of the Vanilla one. [b]You must choose only one file.
[/b]The one you choose will no longer be compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13052]Tap Giant Crops[/url] mod.
